key_highlights: ASX recorded its third consecutive week of gains driven by strong rallies in materials and technology sectors.
Australian unemployment climbed to a five-year high, squashing RBA rate hike expectations and weakening the AUD.
Residential property market sentiment deteriorated sharply, with Sydney auction markets slipping into contraction mode.
Global trade risks and 'China Shock 2.0' concerns heighten scrutiny over Australian export volumes and commodity demand.

sectors.trend: Strong exploration results and production fast-tracks across gold and critical minerals supported broad sector strength.
sectors.implications: Robust cash flows and currency tailwinds for gold and critical mineral producers, though China overcapacity poses risks for base metals.

sectors.trend: Weakening labor market and mounting property auction stress temper rate hike expectations, dampening net interest margin expansion.
sectors.implications: Major retail banks face elevated credit risk and slower mortgage book growth as auction clearance rates deteriorate.

sectors.trend: Tech equities rallied alongside miners, buoyed by declining local yields and reduced risk of RBA monetary tightening.
sectors.implications: Valuation support persists for high-multiple ASX tech leaders as monetary policy constraints ease.

sectors.trend: Domestic gas supply concerns and net-zero legal and regulatory scrutiny complicate resource development.
sectors.implications: Heightened domestic gas pricing volatility creates mixed operating conditions for domestic energy suppliers and industrial users.

sectors.trend: Rising unemployment and property market distress pressure residential and discretionary commercial asset values.
sectors.implications: Residential developers and discretionary retail REITs face valuation headwinds, though falling yields may provide yield support.

key_themes: Labor market deterioration halts RBA tightening narrative and pressures AUD/USD.
Resource sector resilience and gold outperformance drive equity market gains.
Housing market stress accelerates in major metropolitan auction markets.
Heightened geopolitical and global trade friction ('China Shock 2.0') clouds export outlook.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate out of cyclical discretionary consumer stocks into defensive dividend-payers and global revenue earners.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Downturn and Mortgage Stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight major retail banking exposures with elevated domestic residential mortgage concentration.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China Trade and Supply Overhang ('China Shock 2.0')
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify commodity exposure toward gold and defense-critical minerals; hedge bulk commodity volatility.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold producers and critical minerals developers
opportunities.rationale: Producers benefit from high commodity prices, production fast-tracking, and a weaker Australian dollar.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to ASX technology leaders
opportunities.rationale: Cooling interest rate expectations reduce discount rate pressure, sustaining valuation multiples.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to major domestic retail banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Five-year high unemployment and falling auction clearance rates elevate default risks and compress loan margins.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge core index exposures against macro decoupling
defensive_moves.rationale: Divergence between equity benchmark gains and deteriorating real economy indicators signals correction risks.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 as resource and tech momentum counters deteriorating employment metrics and property downturn.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive as an eventual RBA easing cycle cushions domestic demand and supports corporate balance sheets.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and post-meeting policy statement
China economic activity indicators and stimulus execution
Domestic labor force and wage price index data
watch_list: Sydney and Melbourne property auction clearance rates
Iron ore 62% Fe CFR and spot gold prices
